items.fullName: Angelbird CFexpress Card & SSD2GO Firmware Update Tool
items.summary: Desktop tool that flashes Angelbird (and RED-branded) CFexpress Type A/B cards and SSD2GO PKT MK3 drives. Needs an Angelbird or RED CFexpress reader; erases the card.

specs.Required reader: Angelbird CFexpress A/B MK1/MK2 or RED CFexpress Type B reader (USB4 mode needs tool 1.8.0+)
specs.Supported media: AV PRO CFexpress A/B (all editions), RED PRO CFexpress, SSD2GO PKT MK3
specs.Current card firmware: AVX2.30 (CFexpress B), AVX4.00 (SE B v4 MK2), AVX2.82 (A v4), RD5.04 (RED PRO v4 B)

firmware.notes: Tool v1.8.0 adds USB4-mode support for the Performance Card Reader. Latest card firmware: RD5.04 (Jan 2026), AVX4.00/RD4.30/AVX2.30 (Nov 2025), AVX2.82 and SGP1.02 (Aug 2025). The update wipes the card - back up first.

downloads.filename: Angelbird CFexpress Card Firmware Update Tool Win v1.8.0.zip
Angelbird CFexpress Card Firmware Update Tool macOS v1.8.0.dmg

firmware.howTo: 1) Back up the card (update erases it). 2) Install the tool (macOS: allow it in Privacy & Security; see Angelbird's macOS manual). 3) Insert the card in an Angelbird/RED CFexpress reader connected directly by USB-C. 4) Open the tool, select the card, click Update and wait for completion. 5) Re-format the card in camera.

items.fullName: Atomos Ninja 5" HDMI Monitor-Recorder (2023)
items.summary: 2023 Ninja with AtomOS 11, 1000-nit 5-inch screen, HDMI 2.0 and ProRes/DNx recording (RAW via optional ProRes RAW activation).

firmware.notes: 11.18.00 migrates Atomos Cloud Studio users to Mavis Cloud Hub and fixes ATOMOSphere/Frame.io upload reliability (version listed on the Atomos product-support page; release date not shown). Downloads are gated behind a my.atomos.com account/registration.
firmware.howTo: 1) Sign in at my.atomos.com, register the unit and download the AtomOS zip. 2) Unzip and copy the .FW file (ATOMNJV.FW Ninja V, ATOMNJU.FW Ninja Ultra, ATOMNJA.FW Ninja) to the ROOT of a freshly formatted SSD in the docking station (Shinobi II: SD card). 3) Insert the drive, connect mains power, power on; the update runs automatically and reboots. 4) Check Info in the main menu.

items.fullName: Blackmagic Design ATEM Mini Series Live Production Switcher
items.summary: Four- or eight-input HDMI live switcher family with USB webcam output and (Pro/Extreme) streaming/recording. Firmware ships inside the ATEM Switchers software package.

firmware.notes: 10.4.1 is the current ATEM Switchers release (10.3 of 2026-07-09 added USB digital audio output and Blackmagic Cloud Stream Router support on Mini Pro/Extreme and ISO G2 models). Downloads require filling Blackmagic's registration form (gated).
firmware.howTo: 1) On the Blackmagic support page select ATEM Production Switchers, download 'ATEM Switchers 10.4.1' for your OS (registration form) and install. 2) Connect the ATEM Mini by USB-C and power it. 3) Open ATEM Setup; it offers 'Update' when the switcher firmware is older - click it and wait for the reboot.

items.fullName: DJI Osmo Mobile 7P Smartphone Gimbal
items.summary: Foldable 3-axis smartphone gimbal with built-in extension rod and tripod, plus the detachable DJI OM Multifunctional Module for app-free ActiveTrack 7.0, fill light and DJI Mic receiver duty.

specs.Tracking: ActiveTrack 7.0 via OM Multifunctional Module (works without app)

firmware.notes: V01.06.00.02 fixes known issues (shared Osmo Mobile 7/7P release notes). The Oct 2025 V01.05.00.01 added linking DJI Mic 3 transmitters to the DJI OM Multifunctional Module. Requires DJI Mimo V2.9.0 or later. No SD-card firmware file is offered on the DJI download page; release notes PDF: https://dl.djicdn.com/downloads/DJI_Osmo_Mobile_7_Series/RN/20260509/DJI_Osmo_Mobile_7_Series_Release_Notes_en.pdf
firmware.howTo: 1) Charge the gimbal until the battery indicator shows solid green. 2) Install/update the DJI Mimo app. 3) Power on the gimbal and connect to it via Bluetooth in DJI Mimo. 4) Tap Update when DJI Mimo prompts for new firmware; do not exit DJI Mimo or power off until it finishes. 5) If the update fails, restart the gimbal and DJI Mimo, re-pair Bluetooth and retry.

items.fullName: DJI RS 3 Mini 3-Axis Gimbal Stabilizer
items.summary: Lightweight 2 kg-payload gimbal with native vertical shooting and Bluetooth shutter control.

firmware.notes: V01.02.00.00 fixes Bluetooth shutter connection with some cameras and optimizes stabilization. No newer release notes are listed on the DJI downloads page.
firmware.howTo: 1) Install/update the DJI Ronin app (iOS 15+/Android 9+). 2) Power the gimbal on, connect in the app via Bluetooth. 3) When 'Firmware update available' appears at the top, tap it and keep the app connected (gimbal motors power off - support the camera). 4) After reboot run Auto Tune/calibration; settings are reset by the update.

items.fullName: Godox G3 Firmware Update Software (Windows/macOS)
items.summary: Desktop updater used to flash .bin firmware into Godox flashes, strobes, triggers and lights over USB. Required for nearly all Godox firmware on this list.

specs.Connection: USB-C or micro-USB cable to device
specs.Legacy: G1 V0.4 and G2 V0.1 launchers (Windows only) for pre-2018 gear

firmware.notes: G3 V2.0 for Windows posted 2025-11-17; G3 V2.0 for macOS posted 2025-07-25. Legacy G1 (V0.4, 2019-07-22) and G2 (V0.1, 2017-06-12) launchers remain for older products and are .rar archives.
firmware.howTo: 1) Download the G3 zip for your OS and unzip. 2) Windows: run the installer (allow the USB driver). macOS: open the .app; if blocked, allow it under System Settings > Privacy & Security. 3) Connect the Godox device by USB, open G3, select the device's .bin firmware and click Upgrade.

items.fullName: Hollyland LARK M2 Wireless Microphone System
items.summary: Button-sized wireless mic pair (9 g TX) with camera, USB-C and Lightning receiver options.

firmware.notes: V2.0.0.32 charging-case firmware fixes known issues; TX/RX update through the LarkSound app (mobile version) or the app/case (camera version).
firmware.howTo: 1) Install LarkSound (iOS 12+/Android 8+). 2) Charge TX/RX/case, power on and pair with the app via Bluetooth. 3) Tap Firmware Update when prompted and keep everything powered until done. LARK M2 case firmware can alternatively be flashed from the zip per Hollyland's PDF.

items.fullName: Hollyland LARK MAX 2 Wireless Microphone System

firmware.howTo: 1) Charge the gimbal. 2) Install the Insta360 app (iOS/Android) and pair the Flow 2 Pro via Bluetooth. 3) When the app shows a firmware update prompt, keep the phone near the gimbal and tap Update. 4) Wait for the gimbal to restart; do not power off during the update.

items.fullName: ProGrade Digital PG05.5 and PG05.6 CFexpress Reader Firmware Update
items.summary: Windows-only firmware updaters for the PG05.5 (CFexpress B/SD) and PG05.6 (CFexpress B) USB readers; needed only for early serial numbers.

specs.Applies to: PG05.5 with '0','1' or '2' as 4th serial digit; PG05.6 with '0' as 4th serial digit

firmware.notes: Zips posted Jan 2025 on ProGrade's download page; version strings come from the file names. Run on Windows with the reader attached.
firmware.howTo: 1) Check the reader's serial number against ProGrade's rule. 2) On a Windows PC, download the zip for your model and unzip. 3) Connect the reader (no card) and run the firmware .exe. 4) Unplug/replug the reader when finished.

items.fullName: ProGrade Digital Refresh Pro Card Health, Sanitize & Firmware Tool
items.summary: Free utility for ProGrade 'R'-logo cards and readers: checks card health, sanitizes, and applies card firmware updates (CFexpress B, SD, microSD).

specs.Requires: ProGrade reader and card with the 'R' logo (not PG04 reader or 160GB Cobalt Type A)
specs.Functions: Health check, Sanitize, card firmware update
specs.Cost: Free (licence key emailed after a $0 order)

firmware.notes: Current major version 4.0 (shop page); press reports cite 4.0.3 (Apr 2025, macOS 15.3 fix) and a later Sep 2025 sanitize fix. Download link and licence key are emailed after placing a free order - no direct installer link.

downloads.filename: Refresh Pro (link emailed after free order)

firmware.howTo: 1) Place a free order for Refresh Pro on the ProGrade shop; the download link and key arrive by email. 2) Install and launch, enter the key. 3) Insert a ProGrade 'R' card in a ProGrade 'R' reader. 4) Use Firmware Update in the app when a card update is listed.

items.fullName: RØDE Central Desktop Companion & Firmware App

firmware.notes: 2.0.111 adds loading audio recordings from a local directory and stability fixes; 2.0.110 (2026-03-10) added live metering and the option to skip optional firmware updates.

items.fullName: RØDE RØDECaster Duo Audio Production Console

items.fullName: RØDE VideoMic GO II On-Camera Shotgun Microphone

firmware.notes: Firmware is applied through RØDE Central but the model's release-notes page could not be located, so the current version is unknown.

Update all parts of a wireless system to the same version.

items.fullName: Zoom H4essential 32-Bit Float Handy Recorder
items.summary: Four-track 32-bit float handheld recorder with built-in X/Y mics and two XLR/TRS inputs.

firmware.notes: System version 2.30 is the current zip on Zoom's US support page (release date not shown; the 3.x line added AI Noise Reduction, in-recording gain and MP3 recording).
firmware.howTo: 1) Unzip the download; the update file is H4essential.BIN. 2) Copy it to the root of a microSD card formatted in the recorder. 3) Fit fresh batteries, insert the card and power on. 4) Menu > System > Firmware Update > Execute; wait for 'Complete' and restart. 5) Confirm under System > Version.

items.fullName: Blackmagic Design Cinema Camera 6K (L-Mount)

specs.Sensor: 36 x 24 mm full-frame HDR, 6048 x 4032 open gate
specs.Video: 6K 3:2 open gate up to 36p, 6K 16:9 up to 60p, Blackmagic RAW

firmware.notes: Blackmagic Camera Setup 10.3 (14 Sep 2026) is the current unified updater for all current Blackmagic cameras. 10.3 itself targets URSA Cine 12K LF (Generation 6 Color Science, pre-record, dual LUTs, SMPTE 2110, DaVinci Resolve color corrector, 4-channel audio, Blackmagic RAW 4.6K crop) and bundles Blackmagic RAW 6.0. Latest Cinema Camera 6K-specific release: Blackmagic Camera 10.2.2 (10 Aug 2026) added phase detect autofocus (continuous, face and object detect, AF transition speed), Blackmagic Cloud stream routing, pre-record and 4-channel audio recording.
firmware.howTo: 1) Download Blackmagic Camera Setup 10.3 from the support page (use the 'Download Only' link to skip registration) and install it. 2) Fully charge/power the camera and connect it to the computer with a USB-C cable. 3) Power on the camera. 4) Open Blackmagic Camera Setup, click the camera, and click 'Update' when prompted. 5) Do not disconnect or power off until the update completes.

firmware.notes: Adds Activation for the DMW-SFU3A upgrade key (ARRI LogC3 photo style) and support for the DMW-XLR2 adaptor; stability improvements. Note: bodies on v2.0 or lower must first update to v2.2 before v3.0.
firmware.howTo: 1) Fully charge the battery and remove any battery grip. 2) Format a card in the camera. 3) Download the zip from the Panasonic page (accept the licence), extract it and copy the single .bin file to the ROOT of the card. 4) Insert the card, power on, press MENU/SET, choose Setup > [Firmware Version] > [Firmware Update] and confirm Yes. 5) Wait 3-5 min; do not power off or remove the card.

items.fullName: Ricoh GR III Digital Camera
items.summary: Pocketable APS-C compact with a 28mm-equivalent f/2.8 lens, sensor-shift stabilisation and snap focus. The classic street-photography camera.

firmware.notes: Version 2.10 (2025-10-23) adds a 'GF-2 Flash Mode' exposure mode that auto-adjusts exposure when the GF-2 external flash is attached. Same file covers GR III, Street Edition, Diary Edition and GR III HDF. Cannot be reverted.
firmware.howTo: 1) Format an SD card (32MB+) in the camera. 2) Unzip and copy fwdc239b.bin to the card root. 3) Fully charge the battery (DB-110), power off, insert card. 4) Hold the Menu button while powering on. 5) Select Execute > OK when 'Update the camera firmware' appears. 6) Wait for 'Update completed', power off, remove card (format it before reuse). 7) Check Setup > Firmware Info/Options.

firmware.howTo: 1) Connect the BF to a computer with a USB-C cable; on the camera's USB Mode Select screen choose Mass Storage. 2) Copy BF__V104.bin to the root (top level) of the camera drive, not into a folder. 3) Safely eject, disconnect. 4) SYSTEM menu > INFORMATION / FIRMWARE > FIRMWARE UPDATE > confirm. 5) Wait for 'Firmware update complete'; camera restarts. 6) Verify version under INFORMATION / FIRMWARE.

items.fullName: Sigma fp Mirrorless Camera

firmware.notes: The issue where ISO sensitivity and aperture values were occasionally not displayed correctly during tethered shooting has been fixed.
firmware.howTo: 1) Format an SD card in the camera; full battery. 2) Copy FP__V502.BIN to the card root (not DCIM). 3) Insert card, power on. 4) MENU > Setup > Firmware Update > Camera > Yes. 5) Wait for completion and restart. 6) Check version under Setup > Information. Note: update SIGMA Photo Pro / Capture Pro as needed for new features.

items.fullName: Sony FX2 Full-Frame Cinema Camera

firmware.notes: Fixes DCI 4K 24p with 48fps shooting recording at normal speed when APS-C S35 Shooting is Off/Auto, and fixes unexpected power-off with a mount adapter attached despite sufficient charge.
firmware.howTo: 1) Fully charge the battery (3+ bars) and detach any vertical grip. 2) Format a memory card in the camera. 3) Copy BODYDATA.DAT to the card root (only one copy on the card; do not rename). 4) Insert the card in the camera. 5) Menu > Setup > Setup Option > Version > Body > Software Update > Execute (about 6 min; do not remove battery/card). Alternatively push the update from the Creators' App (iOS/Android).

firmware.notes: Official download is AF75F18_v07.zip, but the page text still reads 'Latest Version: AF 75mm F1.8 FE Version 5' (improved face detection in video on a9, stability) - the posted file is newer than the text. Requires Lens Station (E) + Lens Manager.
firmware.howTo: 1) Download and install Samyang Lens Manager (Windows V2.81 / Mac V2.77) from the firmware page; Windows may also need the Lens Station USB driver. 2) Click Download for your lens on the firmware page and unzip the .hex firmware file. 3) Mount the lens on the matching Samyang Lens Station (E-mount station for FE lenses, X station for X lenses) and connect the station to the computer by USB; some newer lenses with a built-in USB-C port connect directly instead. 4) In Lens Manager, read the current firmware version, choose Firmware Update, select the .hex file and start; do not disconnect until it reports success. 5) Re-read the version to confirm.

specs.Mount: Sony E / Fujifilm X / L-Mount / Canon RF

firmware.notes: Firmware exists only for L-Mount and Canon RF on Sigma's page; no Sony E or Fujifilm X update has been published. L-Mount Ver.1.1 (2025-06-26): The exposure stability has been improved. | Canon RF Ver.1.0.1 (2024-12-19): The operational stability has been improved. AF operation during zooming when shooting video has been improved.
firmware.howTo: L-Mount (in-camera): 1) Update camera body firmware first; full battery. 2) Format an SD card in the camera. 3) Copy the .plf file to the card root (not DCIM). 4) Attach lens, power on, MENU > Setup > Firmware Update > Lens > Yes. 5) Wait for 'complete' and restart. (Procedure shown is for SIGMA fp/BF; Leica/Panasonic L-Mount bodies: follow that camera's manual.) Alternative: SIGMA USB Dock UD-11 + SIGMA Optimization Pro. || Canon RF (in-camera): unzip SGxxx.zip/.dmg to get SGxxx.afu, copy it to the root of a card formatted in the camera, attach lens, set P/Tv/Av/M, then Function Settings menu > Firmware Ver. > Lens, and follow the prompts.

firmware.notes: L-Mount Ver.1.5 (2026-03-18): Added the ability to assign specific functions to the focus ring during AF.* Added the option to change the rotation direction of the focus ring during MF.* Added the option to display the aperture value as a T-stop during video recording.* *Only on supported cameras. | Sony E Ver.05 (2026-06-25): Fixed an issue where the monitor would rarely black out and freeze during shooting when combined with the Sony α7 V.
firmware.howTo: L-Mount (in-camera): 1) Update camera body firmware first; full battery. 2) Format an SD card in the camera. 3) Copy the .plf file to the card root (not DCIM). 4) Attach lens, power on, MENU > Setup > Firmware Update > Lens > Yes. 5) Wait for 'complete' and restart. (Procedure shown is for SIGMA fp/BF; Leica/Panasonic L-Mount bodies: follow that camera's manual.) Alternative: SIGMA USB Dock UD-11 + SIGMA Optimization Pro. || Sony E (computer): 1) Install the Sony Camera Driver (Apple-silicon Macs: change security policy per Sigma PDF). 2) Run the Update_Sigma... updater (Mac: as administrator) with camera NOT yet connected. 3) Set camera USB Connection to Mass Storage if required; remove memory card. 4) Attach lens, connect camera via USB, follow Next prompts. 5) Wait for 'Lens update complete', close updater, disconnect, remove/reinsert battery. Supported: Windows 10/11, macOS 12-14 per Sigma.

firmware.notes: Improved AF performance during zooming; with the a9 III in AF-S/DMF/MF supports continuous shooting up to ~120 fps; improved AF assist function. Nikon Z version is at Ver.2 (2024-11-21) and updates via TAMRON Lens Utility: https://www.tamron.com/global/consumer/support/download/firmware/a057/nikon_z/.
firmware.howTo: 1) Lens has no USB port: update through a Sony E-mount camera body. Mount the lens with the camera off, fully charge the battery, remove the memory card. 2) Download and run the Tamron 'Lens System Software updater' (Update_xxx.exe / .dmg) on Windows 11/10 or macOS (see Update Manual; Mac needs a preparation step). 3) On the camera set Setup > USB Connection to Mass Storage, connect camera to computer with the original Sony USB cable, click Next in the updater, confirm Current version, Start. 4) Wait for 'Lens update complete', remove battery, power on and check Setup > Version.

firmware.howTo: 1) Install TAMRON Lens Utility Ver.5.0 (Windows 11 / macOS 13-15, 26) from the Lens Utility download page; on Mac install the bundled CP210x VCP driver first. 2) Connect the lens's USB-C port directly to the computer with a TAMRON Connection Cable (CC-150 USB-A to C or CC-350 USB-C to C); no camera needed. 3) Open Lens Utility > Firmware Update and follow the prompts. Note: firmware updates are PC-only; the Lens Utility Mobile app (Android/iOS) cannot update firmware. Updated lenses cannot be reverted to older firmware.

firmware.notes: No firmware update has been released for the Sony E version (Tamron's firmware page for B070 Sony E lists no versions). The Fujifilm X version has Ver.2 (2022-11-17), a card-file update (XFUP0805.DAT): https://www.tamron.com/global/consumer/support/download/firmware/b070/fujifilm_x/.
firmware.howTo: Nothing to install for Sony E. If Tamron publishes one, it would be a computer-run 'Lens System Software updater' applied through the camera body (no USB port on the lens).

items.fullName: Tamron 18-300mm f/3.5-6.3 Di III-A VC VXD Lens (Sony E, APS-C)
items.summary: 16.6x APS-C all-in-one zoom with VC stabilization and VXD AF. Sony E and Fujifilm X versions have no USB port; Nikon Z (2025-08) and Canon RF (2025-09) versions were added later.

specs.Mount: Sony E APS-C (also Fujifilm X, Nikon Z, Canon RF)

firmware.notes: Improved AF tracking performance when shooting moving subjects; compatible with the AF Assist function during video recording. Other mounts: Fujifilm X Ver.3 (2022-11-17, card file XFUP0801.DAT) at https://www.tamron.com/global/consumer/support/download/firmware/b061/fujifilm_x/; Canon RF Ver.2 (2025-10-30, via TAMRON Lens Utility) at https://www.tamron.com/global/consumer/support/download/firmware/b061/canon_rf/.
firmware.howTo: 1) Lens has no USB port: update through a Sony E-mount camera body. Mount the lens with the camera off, fully charge the battery, remove the memory card. 2) Download and run the Tamron 'Lens System Software updater' (Update_xxx.exe / .dmg) on Windows 11/10 or macOS (see Update Manual; Mac needs a preparation step). 3) On the camera set Setup > USB Connection to Mass Storage, connect camera to computer with the original Sony USB cable, click Next in the updater, confirm Current version, Start. 4) Wait for 'Lens update complete', remove battery, power on and check Setup > Version.

items.fullName: Tamron 20-40mm f/2.8 Di III VXD Lens (Sony E)
items.summary: Very compact f/2.8 wide-to-normal zoom aimed at vloggers and travel, with VXD AF and a USB-C port for Lens Utility.

firmware.notes: Added compatibility with TAMRON Lens Utility Ver.5.0 and TAMRON Lens Utility Mobile Ver.5.0 (required for Lens Utility 5.0 / TAMRON-LINK features).
firmware.howTo: 1) Install TAMRON Lens Utility Ver.5.0 (Windows 11 / macOS 13-15, 26) from the Lens Utility download page; on Mac install the bundled CP210x VCP driver first. 2) Connect the lens's USB-C port directly to the computer with a TAMRON Connection Cable (CC-150 USB-A to C or CC-350 USB-C to C); no camera needed. 3) Open Lens Utility > Firmware Update and follow the prompts. Note: firmware updates are PC-only; the Lens Utility Mobile app (Android/iOS) cannot update firmware. Updated lenses cannot be reverted to older firmware.

firmware.notes: V1.28 (FE): added compatibility with the Sony A7M5 (a7 V). Listed as 'Update via PC'. Z-mount: V1.08, 2025-10-24 (fixed known issues, stability), update via mobile app or PC software (viltrox.com/pages/af-135-1-8-lab-z).

items.fullName: Viltrox AF 13mm f/1.4 Lens (APS-C)

specs.Mount: Fujifilm X (also Sony E, Nikon Z)

firmware.notes: No firmware is currently listed on the official XF, E or Z download pages (manuals only). Earlier firmware existed for this lens but is no longer posted; check with the Viltrox Lens PC software.
firmware.howTo: 1) Download and install the 'Viltrox Lens' desktop software (Mac zip / Win) linked on the lens's download page. 2) Remove the lens from the camera and connect its USB-C port to the computer with a USB data cable. 3) Open Viltrox Lens: it reads the lens, shows the current firmware and offers the newer version; click Update and wait until the progress bar completes (do not unplug). Legacy drag-and-drop method (older firmware zips): the lens mounts as a 'Viltrox DFU' drive; unzip the firmware (.vtx/.bin/.dat), drag it onto the drive, the drive ejects, the lens updates for ~5 s and remounts; open DeviceInformation.txt on the drive to confirm the version.

firmware.howTo: 1) Download and install the 'Viltrox Lens' desktop software (Mac zip / Win) linked on the lens's download page. 2) Remove the lens from the camera and connect its USB-C port to the computer with a USB data cable. 3) Open Viltrox Lens: it reads the lens, shows the current firmware and offers the newer version; click Update and wait until the progress bar completes (do not unplug). Legacy drag-and-drop method (older firmware zips): the lens mounts as a 'Viltrox DFU' drive; unzip the firmware (.vtx/.bin/.dat), drag it onto the drive, the drive ejects, the lens updates for ~5 s and remounts; open DeviceInformation.txt on the drive to confirm the version.

versions.name: Windows 11
versions.summary: The current Windows 11 release for Intel/AMD PCs. One ISO covers Home, Pro and Education; the edition is picked by your product key during setup.
versions.notes: Requires TPM 2.0, Secure Boot-capable UEFI, 4 GB RAM and 64 GB storage. Microsoft only publishes the newest build; older releases are no longer offered.

versions.name: Windows 11
versions.summary: Windows 11 for Arm devices: Snapdragon X laptops, Surface Pro X/11, and Apple-silicon Macs inside Parallels, VMware Fusion or UTM.
versions.notes: Not for Intel/AMD PCs. On an Apple-silicon Mac this is the image you use for a Windows virtual machine.

versions.name: Windows 10
versions.summary: The final Windows 10 release. Mainstream support ended 14 Oct 2025; Extended Security Updates run one more year for enrolled PCs.
versions.notes: Both 64-bit and 32-bit ISOs are offered. Use it for older PCs that fail the Windows 11 requirements.

versions.name: Windows Server
versions.summary: 180-day evaluation of the current Windows Server. The English ISO is a direct download; other languages are on the Evaluation Center.
versions.notes: Evaluation media; convert to a licensed edition later with DISM /Set-Edition.

versions.name: Windows 11
versions.editionName: Windows 11 Insider Preview ISO (Canary / Dev / Beta / Release Preview)
versions.summary: Pre-release builds for testing. Needs a Microsoft account enrolled in the Windows Insider Program.

tools.name: Windows 11 Media Creation Tool
tools.what: Microsoft's own tool: builds a bootable USB or saves an ISO, on a Windows PC.

tools.name: Windows 10 Media Creation Tool
tools.what: Builds Windows 10 22H2 install media on a Windows PC.

tools.name: Rufus (portable)
tools.what: The go-to bootable-USB maker on Windows. Handles 4 GB+ install.wim and can skip the TPM / online-account checks.

tools.name: balenaEtcher
tools.what: Raw image writer for Linux and rescue ISOs on Mac/Windows (not for Windows installers).

tools.name: wimlib (Homebrew)
tools.what: Needed on macOS to split install.wim over 4 GB when making a Windows USB:  brew install wimlib

tools.name: PC Health Check
tools.what: Tells you whether a PC meets the Windows 11 requirements (TPM 2.0, CPU, Secure Boot).
